selectedCandidate.hypothesis: A bullish trend that sweeps value and reclaims the recent high can provide a distinct LONG continuation edge.
selectedCandidate.marketMechanism: A downside liquidity sweep resets positioning before demand reclaims the local range.
selectedCandidate.entryLogic: Bull alignment, bounded liquidity sweep, bullish reclaim and next-open execution.
selectedCandidate.invalidationLogic: The swept value area is lost on a closed candle.
selectedCandidate.expectedFailureMode: The sweep is distribution and the trend has already turned lower.

selectedCandidate.marketMechanism: Failed expansion leaves demand above invalidation while supply controls the reclaim failure.
selectedCandidate.entryLogic: Closed failed-breakout frame, lower high, bearish confirmation and bounded next-open entry.

candidate.hypothesis: A support breakdown, bounded retest from below, rejection and continuation confirmation should improve short entry location.
candidate.marketMechanism: Former support becomes overhead supply after trapped longs test the broken level.
candidate.entryLogic: Closed support break, below-level retest, rejection close and lower continuation close.
candidate.invalidationLogic: The broken support is reclaimed on a closed candle.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: Absorption turns the breakdown into a bear trap.

candidate.hypothesis: Compression followed by downside range expansion and participation confirmation can expose a controlled continuation edge.
candidate.marketMechanism: Stored range energy resolves lower when volume and realized volatility expand together.
candidate.entryLogic: Closed compression, downside range expansion below the prior floor, volume and volatility confirmation.
candidate.invalidationLogic: The compression floor is reclaimed after the expansion.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: A one-bar volatility shock mean reverts inside the range.

candidate.hypothesis: In a mature bear trend, a rebound into value followed by a fresh lower-low rejection can offer continuation without shorting the initial impulse.
candidate.marketMechanism: Counter-trend liquidity is absorbed near value before the dominant supply regime resumes.
candidate.entryLogic: Bear alignment, bounded rebound into EMA/value, bearish rejection and fresh lower-low confirmation.
candidate.invalidationLogic: A closed reclaim above the rebound value zone.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: The rebound is a true trend reversal rather than a pullback.
